policy.warmup: one render(0) after compile; then two render(0) before each reading, or the case's steps
policy.control: the case's program without its target: its frame must differ from the case's on both backends; null where the target makes the frame
policy.source: where the case's context came from when it was written: a copy of the effect's parity case, or authored for this render context
policy.recorded: seeds and parameters are read from the compiled program, expectedAlpha from the pin, and the budgets by performancePolicy, by the record modes of scripts/audit-portable-migration.mjs
